description: This Java class 'PartyHelper' provides utility methods for retrieving and formatting party names within the OFBiz framework, including handling of party entities, name formatting, and external entity queries.

classes.name: PartyHelper
classes.description: A utility class for handling party name retrieval and formatting within the OFBiz framework.

methods.name: getPartyName
methods.description: Retrieves the party name for a given GenericValue object, with optional last name first formatting.

methods.name: getPartyName
methods.description: Retrieves the party name for a given delegator and partyId, with optional last name first formatting.

methods.name: getPartyName
methods.description: Retrieves the party name based on a GenericValue object, considering entity type and formatting.

methods.name: formatPartyNameObject
methods.description: Formats the party name from a GenericValue object, optionally placing the last name first.
